title: A DEFINE FUNCTION with the name of a model function replaces it for the query
query: DEFINE FUNCTION Twice = ( x : NUMERIC ) => x * 3

source.quote: A query function overrides a model function with the same name.
source.supports: the query definition is the one used

derivation: The model Twice multiplies by 2 and would give 4. The query redefines Twice to multiply by 3: 2 * 3 = 6.
